q1_issues.issue: The bare mass-noun generic subject 'Cancer' is placed in the Agent slot of a flat unmarked event, where *Quantifiers, generics & scope* prescribes the distributing Implication rule for a verbal generic over a kind.

q2_gaps: Aggregate statistical kind-level claim (bare-kind subject + counted object + periodicity, 'Cancer kills thousands of people every year'): the kind-relation form requires bare kind NPs on both sides, while the distributing rule form would falsely assert the aggregate yearly count of each individual instance of the kind, so neither licensed form fits.
notes: Cardinality ('thousands' -> CardinalityPhrase on a GroupOf), roles (kill destroys -> Patient; inanimate transitive subject -> Agent) and the periodic (Every e 1 year) with no tense atom are all handled correctly.
